chore(release): 1.2.0 "Real-library fixes"

fix(T1.4): make the degradation contract match what each script reads

Addresses Copilot review on #31.

- face_quality: declare ZSIZE/ZYAWANGLE/ZFACEISINCENTER (face_score
  section); compute_face_score falls back to neutral values without them.
- similarity_finder: declare all 17 FEATURE_COLUMNS (similarity_features);
  a missing feature counts as 0 and shifts cosine scores.
- icloud_status / shared_library: drop the publish_dates, visibility and
  participation sections, whose columns were selected but never read
  (and their now-unused logical names).
- people_analyzer: a missing ZFACECOUNT stays null instead of becoming 0.
- cleanup_executor and smart_export (hand-written mains) now include
  "degraded" in preview, plan and result JSON.
- timeline_recap --narrative appends the degraded note.
- test_degradation asserts the "degraded" key is present instead of
  .get()-defaulting it. The rich fixture gains the newly declared
  columns, and there are regression tests for the narrative note and the
  null face_count.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(T1.10): diagnose old Python before imports fail; fixed check list

Addresses Copilot review on #32.

- On Python 3.9 (stock macOS python3), importing _common fails with a
  TypeError on its `X | None` annotations, so doctor's python check
  could never run. New _bootstrap is doctor's first project import; on
  < 3.10 it prints the fix and exits 1. Verified against a real 3.9.25:
  before, `TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for |`; after, the
  fix message.
- Every report lists the same checks (CHECK_NAMES) in order. read_access
  and optimize_storage are now explicit "skip" when the library is
  missing or unreadable, instead of being absent.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

test(T1.20): drop pragma_table_info() from the allowed-reads test

On SQLite 3.40 (python.org 3.10 builds, the CI floor) building the
pragma_table_info virtual table authorizes internal UPDATEs on
sqlite_master, which the guard denies. No script uses the table-valued
form; document that PRAGMA table_info(...) is the supported spelling.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

chore(T0.13): add CHANGELOG and RELEASING, bump to 1.0.3

CHANGELOG.md follows Keep a Changelog and is backfilled to 1.0.0. No tags
existed, so versions are anchored on commits, and 1.0.1, which was published
without a repo bump, is recorded as such. RELEASING.md documents the
publish-on-merge flow: bump SKILL.md + pyproject.toml, update the CHANGELOG
and ROADMAP, run the checks, merge, verify the ClawHub run and listing, then
tag and publish the drafted GitHub Release.

ROADMAP.md marks the 1.0.3 items shipped and records the Python floor
decision.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
